sentences.text: Bacteroides ovatus is a member of the gut microbiota that a review describes as strongly associated with host health and as a candidate for next-generation probiotics.
That review also reports that the abundance of Bacteroides ovatus fluctuates across clinical indications and responds to probiotics, prebiotics, natural products and dietary patterns.
In an in vitro faecal fermentation study, a Bacteroides ovatus strain was identified as a key degrader of chondroitin sulfate and its genome carried 649 carbohydrate-active enzyme genes.
A case report described cultures from a deep chest wall abscess that grew Actinomyces turicensis and Bacteroides ovatus.
